items.title: Two papers accepted to NDSS 2027
items.body: [TPUZZ: Cross-Domain State-Aware Fuzzing of Google Pixel TPU](publications.html#tpuzz-ndss27) and [Hardware-Rooted Inference-Time Verification for LLM Execution on Untrusted GPUs (ARGUS)](publications.html#argus-ndss27) have been accepted to NDSS 2027.

items.title: Two papers accepted to ACM CCS 2026
items.body: [From Fault to Oracle: Breaking Google Pixel TPU Hardware Memory Isolation via Trusted Deserialization Faults](publications.html#fault-oracle-ccs26) and [Trapped Handler: A Practical Performance Degradation Attack on NVIDIA vGPU via Preemption Manipulation](publications.html#trapped-handler-ccs26) have been accepted to ACM CCS 2026.

items.title: FLASH accepted to SIGOPS ATC 2026
items.body: [FLASH: Fault-Led, Attested, Secure Hybrid-Key Checkpoint for Confidential Inference](publications.html#flash-atc26) has been accepted to the 2026 ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference.

items.title: MC-ORAM appears at ISCA 2026
items.body: [MC-ORAM: A Mask-Assisted and Counter-Based Non-Deterministic ORAM Inside VM-Based TEEs](publications.html#mc-oram-isca26), joint work with Yongqin Wang, Rachit Rajat, Jonghyun Lee, and Murali Annavaram, appears at ISCA 2026.

items.title: Hollow-LLM Attack appears at IEEE S&P 2026
items.body: [Hollow-LLM Attack: Computationally Trivial Weights in Zero-Knowledge Verification of LLM Inference](publications.html#hollow-llm-sp26), by Chen Gong, Beijie Liu, and Mengyuan Li, appears at the 2026 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy.

items.title: Talk at the University of Chicago
items.body: Prof. Li gave a talk titled *Confidential Computing and Trusted Execution Environments: Challenges and Opportunities for Trustworthy AI* at the [University of Chicago Department of Computer Science](https://computerscience.uchicago.edu/events/event/mengyuan-li-usc-confidential-computing-and-trusted-execution-environments-challenges-and-opportunities-for-trustworthy-ai/).

items.title: WAVE appears at ASPLOS 2026
items.body: [WAVE: Leveraging Architecture Observation for Privacy-Preserving Model Oversight](publications.html#wave-asplos26), by Haoxuan Xu, Chen Gong, Beijie Liu, Haizhong Zheng, Beidi Chen, and Mengyuan Li, is published in the ASPLOS 2026 proceedings. The artifact is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/sept-usc/Wave).

items.title: SCALE presented at HPCA 2026
items.body: [SCALE](publications.html#scale-hpca26), which tackles communication bottlenecks in confidential multi-GPU machine learning, was presented at HPCA 2026 in the Distributed and Multi-GPU Training session.

items.title: Writing in Symbiosis at the NeurIPS 2025 Creative AI Track
items.body: [Writing in Symbiosis: Mapping Human Creative Agency in the AI Era](publications.html#writing-symbiosis-neurips25), by Vivan Doshi and Mengyuan Li, appears in the NeurIPS 2025 Creative AI Track.

items.title: RMP entry caching study at HASP 2025
items.body: [A Close Look at RMP Entry Caching and Its Security Implications in SEV-SNP](publications.html#rmp-caching-hasp25) appeared at HASP 2025. AMD published security bulletin [AMD-SB-3036](https://www.amd.com/en/resources/product-security/bulletin/amd-sb-3036.html) on October 20, 2025, crediting the researchers.

items.title: Chekhov's Gun appears at ACM CCS 2025
items.body: [Chekhov's Gun: Uncovering Hidden Risks in macOS Application-Sandboxed PID-Domain Services](publications.html#chekhovs-gun-ccs25), led by Minghao Lin, is published in the ACM CCS 2025 proceedings.

items.title: Few-shot graph OOD detection at ECML PKDD 2025
items.body: [Few-Shot Graph Out-of-Distribution Detection with LLMs](publications.html#fewshot-graph-ood-ecmlpkdd25), first-authored by PhD student Haoyan Xu, is published in the ECML PKDD 2025 proceedings.

items.title: SoK on TEE design choices at ACM ASIACCS 2024
items.body: [SoK: Understanding Design Choices and Pitfalls of Trusted Execution Environments](publications.html#sok-tee-asiaccs24) appears at ACM ASIACCS 2024.

items.title: SEPT Lab starts at USC
items.body: Mengyuan Li joined the [Thomas Lord Department of Computer Science](https://www.cs.usc.edu/) at USC as an Assistant Professor and started SEPT Lab.
